nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name, set to RAPPUPPY in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol, set to RAPPUPPY in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 '_totalSupply' storing the total token supply created in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token balances of each holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' tracking allowances for transferFrom.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals and mints the whole _totalSupply to msg.sender.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning the token balance of tokenOwner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and decreases the caller allowance.
SafeMath helper performing checked addition (require c >= a).
SafeMath helper performing checked subtraction (require b <= a).
SafeMath helper performing checked multiplication.
SafeMath helper performing checked division (require b > 0).
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used as minter, allowance owner and token holder.
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) arithmetic call inside transfer.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) arithmetic call inside transfer.
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) and allowance subtraction calls inside transferFrom.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) arithmetic call inside transferFrom.
Function parameter 'spender' of approve.
Function parameter 'tokens' of approve, the allowance amount.
Function parameter 'to' of transfer, destination address.
Function parameter 'tokens' of transfer, amount to move.
Function parameter 'from' of transferFrom, source address.
Function parameter 'to' of transferFrom, destination address.
Function parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, amount to move.
Function parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf.
Function parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance.
Function parameter 'spender' of allowance.
Local return variable 'c' of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Local return variable 'c' of SafeMath.safeSub.
Local return variable 'c' of SafeMath.safeMul.
Local return variable 'c' of SafeMath.safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply, so msg.sender indexes the balances mapping.
_totalSupply is assigned into balances[msg.sender] during token minting.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve and as the spender key in transferFrom/allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the spender parameter into the allowed mapping key.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value in allowed.
transfer passes the tokens parameter into safeSub, which relies on checked arithmetic.
Result of safeSub in transfer is written back into balances[msg.sender], directly affecting the arithmetic safety of balances.
Result of safeAdd in transfer is written into balances[to].
transferFrom passes the tokens parameter into safeSub for balances and allowance subtraction.
safeSub result in transferFrom is written to balances[from], depending on checked arithmetic.
safeAdd result in transferFrom is written to balances[to].
transfer uses the 'to' parameter as the index of the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses the 'from' parameter as the index of the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses the 'to' parameter as the index of the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] using the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the spender parameter.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to perform checked balance subtraction.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to perform checked balance addition.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeSub for balance and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeAdd for destination balance addition.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token holder, giving it full supply control.
approve authorizes via msg.sender as the owner of the allowance.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address drives the state change.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter spender only feeds the allowed mapping write inside approve and is meaningless outside that function.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value written by approve and belongs to that function's semantics.
Parameter to is only used as the balances mapping key inside transfer.
Parameter tokens is the exact amount fed into the safeSub arithmetic operation inside transfer.
Parameter from only indexes balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
Parameter to only indexes the balances mapping inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount consumed by the safeSub arithmetic calls inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only the lookup key for balances in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner is only the first lookup key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is only the second lookup key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Local variable c is the return value of safeAdd and carries no independent meaning.
Local variable c is the return value of safeSub and carries no independent meaning.
Local variable c is the return value of safeMul and carries no independent meaning.
Local variable c is the return value of safeDiv and carries no independent meaning.
